Old forums kept their comments readable with a different trick, and those pages are still online:

Some forums still wrap their comments in a pre tag, because it was the only way to keep the line breaks a writer typed. That habit is old, but the pages are still out there, and a reader should never have to squint at monospace text to follow an ordinary conversation about reading.

The answer usually includes a small script, and code has to stay exactly as written:

const rollup = entries.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.tokens, 0);
console.log(`weekly total: ${rollup} tokens across ${entries.length} sessions`);

Thanks in advance — and please keep the answers short.
